items.title: UHealth and UnitedHealthcare yet to reach full negotiation settlement - The Miami Hurricane
items.reason: This reports an ongoing negotiation dispute between a major health system (UHealth) and a major payer (UnitedHealthcare), which constitutes a payer-provider dispute relevant to revenue cycle operations, though it appears to be a contracting negotiation rather than formal litigation or enforcement action.
items.summary: UHealth and UnitedHealthcare have not yet reached a full negotiation settlement, indicating an unresolved contracting dispute between the University of Miami health system and the major national payer. The lack of settlement means contract terms, reimbursement rates, and network status remain in flux, directly affecting UHealth's revenue cycle, claims processing, and patient billing protocols for the UnitedHealthcare population. Revenue-cycle teams must monitor this dispute for potential impacts on payment timelines, claim denials, and out-of-network billing obligations, as unresolved payer negotiations can disrupt cash flow and require temporary billing policy adjustments.
